title: IFCFill: missingness-aware preprocessing for synthetic data generation
description: IFCFill transforms incomplete tabular data into Integer, Float and Categorical (IFC) variables that synthetic-data generators can consume, and reconstructs the original representation and missingness after synthesis. Missingness can be restored as produced by the generator, with exact per-variable rates placed by a conditional missingness model (hybrid), or by matching the marginal or joint missingness distribution of the real data.
